title: billing.plan.updated payload
description: The `data` payload of the `billing.plan.updated` event: a published plan changed. The payload is the plan's whole current state and has the same shape as `billing.plan.created` — there is no diff, and there is no list of changed fields. A consumer replaces its copy; there is nothing to merge and nothing to ignore. This is published only when something actually changed, so an event carrying a value equal to the one before it is a publisher bug, not a no-op. The envelope is validated by schemas/event-envelope.schema.json; this schema validates what is inside `data`. The file path is the event type with dots as directory separators. See docs/event-naming.md.

id.description: billing's plan row. Always equal to the envelope's `subject`, and the same value `billing.plan.created` carried — a plan's identity does not change across its updates.

name.description: Display name. Renaming a plan is the change most likely to be reported here and the one no consumer should depend on.

slug.description: Kebab-case, unique, and always one URL segment. A change to this is a change to a URL a customer may have bookmarked, which is why the pattern is enforced rather than merely documented.

price.description: What one unit costs on this plan now. Integer minor units and a currency, never a float.

amount_minor.description: Price per unit per interval, in the currency's minor units. Never negative.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, uppercase. Shape-checked rather than checked against a list of live codes.

interval.description: The billing cadence, now. Changing it changes what a subscriber is charged and when, so it is the change most worth an event.

trial_days.description: Trial length attached to the plan. Applies to subscriptions created after the change, not retroactively to the ones already running.

active.description: Whether the plan can be bought. `false` is how a plan is retired rather than deleted, which is what lets an existing subscription keep its price.

processor_product_id.description: The processor's product id, or null before the plan is registered there.

processor_price_id.description: The processor's price id, or null.

created_at.description: RFC3339 UTC when the plan row was written. Unchanged by this event; present because the payload is the whole row.

updated_at.description: RFC3339 UTC when the plan row last changed. Always equal to the envelope's `time` for this event.
